scope.summary: Seed and prove archetypes ARCH-F, ARCH-G, and ARCH-H per Section 13.27 acceptance archetypes: ARCH-F — muscular male + oversized cock; ARCH-G — slender male + oversized cock (proving genital channels independent of body mass); ARCH-H — futa cross-blend (female body + penis module, zero cross-module conflicts per REQ-035), with the erection continuum working on all three.
acceptance_criteria: BRC-ARCH-F sets muscle mass + definition channels high with penis length/girth at the oversized over-range point (multi-key track interpolation per REQ-009/030, no linear-scaling degeneration at the extreme).

BRC-ARCH-G sets slender male channels with the SAME oversized cock values; the genital channel values are identical between F and G while body channels differ — proving genital/body decoupling by construction.

BRC-ARCH-H builds the futa blend: female body channels via the masc/fem continuum + enabled penis module coexisting with vulva-region config per the spec's mixed-anatomy rules; channel namespaces show zero conflicts (REQ-035 fixture).
The erection continuum (MT-552) sweeps flaccid->erect on all three archetypes without mesh breakage; genital correctives activate per size (MT-555 re-bake lane).
All three recipes deterministic and registered in the QA iterator.
scope.risk_if_missed: The male and futa production lanes — including the oversized-cock requirement stated verbatim by the operator — remain unproven, and mixed-anatomy conflicts surface as unfixable geometry bugs after content exists.

gui_obligation.not_applicable_reason: Backend/solver scope: behavior is observable via TraceProjection, typed TAILOR_BODY_* receipts, and the 13.12 capture APIs; operator/model GUI exposure rides the BodyKit panes (13.27) and is validated there.

hbr_int_009_tier_obligations.reason: Emits/extends the TAILOR_BODY_* KernelEventType family on the EventLedger per Section 13.16 (extends the 13.14 canonical list).
internal_diagnostics ships with WP-KERNEL-012; wire the open diagnostic-event API for this behavior in the WP-KERNEL-016 retrofit.
Palmistry external watcher ships with WP-KERNEL-012/016; long generation/bake/export runs get child-stall watch coverage in the retrofit.

risks: Broad MT scope can hide multiple review targets.
Markdown MT lists may disagree with packet-declared active/next MT truth.
Receipt routing may target an old MT if contract identity is omitted.
minimum_controls: Exactly one primary proof target per MT unless the packet records why not.
MT identity must be stable and referenced by receipt correlation.
Generated projection drift must not wake Coder or Validator by itself.

required_changes_before_execution: Run the accepted source assets, anatomy, genital, creator-tool, DCC, visual, and performance corpora with pinned metrics and exact artifact inspection.
